observed.card: The family has been told to leave for the east. Load what the wagon will carry and go; what is left will be burned. Answer before the time on the “!” runs out, or the family packs what it can and goes by itself. No answer in time, and the family leaves in a rush — the house is lost, burned behind it. Room for 15 in the cart. Food takes 0.25 each, seed 1, cotton 0.5, powder 0.1. Each tool and thing for the house says its room below. What is not loaded is left in the house. food (59 in the house) seed (4 in the house) cotton (6 in the house) powder (2 in the house) hoe (1 in the house, 0.5 each) felling axe (1 in the house, 1 each) For the house, only in a wagon, if there is room: bedding (1 in the house, 2.5 each) iron pot (1 in the house, 1.25 each) Loaded 14.95 of 15. The cart is full: there is no room left for anything more.
